MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.title: Hiro's Pen
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 stacks of [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.flavor: The pen [color=#CC6666]Hiro[/color] often used in middle school. It should have been given to Yuki long ago
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.title: Witch Factor
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.descript: When you play an Attack card, gain 20 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]. When you play a Skill or Power card, lose 10 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b] (some cards may be auto-played)
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.flavor: When the witch factor becomes overactive, a person loses their sanity and turns into a monster-like existence, regarded as a dangerous individual that must be eliminated
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.title: What the Great Witch Once Possessed
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.description:
[color=#CC6666]「Yuki... you are wrong」[/color]
At the start of each combat, gain 6 stacks of [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color]
At the start of your turn, you may choose a card in hand to return to the draw pile
When you first gain [b]【Suspicion】[/b] this combat, lose 2 stacks
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.flavor:
[color=#CC6666]「But... I still want to find [/color][color=#CCCCCC]you[/color][color=#CC6666]」[/color]
[color=#CC6666]「I will come find you now——to judge our [/color][b]【Crime】[/b][color=#CC6666]」[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.title: Witch Records
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.descrip: Upon obtaining, randomly generate 26 cards from the candidate witch card pool, and choose any number to add to your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.flavor: A vast record of material trades between the island and the mansion, as well as intelligence on the imprisoned girls. It also contains profiles and face photos of Ema and everyone else. Deciphering it seems to take a great deal of time
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.selecti: Choose cards to add to your deck
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.title: Dismantled Parts
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.descr: Each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. On the first turn, automatically play all Attack cards against a random enemy.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.flavo: Parts of a crossbow stored in a barrel in the hallway. Disassembled into pieces so small they are hard to repair
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.desc: Gain 1 ammo upon entering each node (max 6). Right-click or two-finger tap to spend 1 ammo and add a [b]【Bullet】[/b] to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.flav: Maximum capacity of 6 rounds. A weapon forged with magic by a girl once held in the prison. When the date changes, 1 round is automatically loaded
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLOODIEDCLOTHING.desc: Lose 26 [b]Max HP[/b]. All Skill cards in your deck gain the [b]【Clever】[/b] enchantment.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.title: Fruit Plate of Memories
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.descriptio: Upon obtaining, choose 1 card in your deck to enchant with [color=#ff99cc][b]【Ema's Apple】[/b][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.flavor: It was an afternoon long ago, the fruit plate Ema brought over
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.selectionS: Choose 1 card to enchant with [color=#ff99cc][b]【Ema's Apple】[/b][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.title: Safe
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.description: Upon obtaining, gain 2 random Ancient relics
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.flavor:
An opened safe.
It has a numeric keypad lock, with bloodstains on the keypad
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.des: At the start of each combat, gain 3 stacks of [b]【Crimson Butterfly】[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.fla:
Anan's sketchbook.
It contains drawings of butterflies.
The artist is Noah, and the butterflies seem to be a kind of protection left for Anan
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.title: Notes
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.description: Upon obtaining, remove all [color=#CC6666]【Death Retracement】[/color] from your deck, then gain a new [color=#CC6666]【Death Retracement】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.flavor: The contract reads: end the old to begin the new
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.title: Ritual Sword
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.descripti: Upon obtaining, add a [b]【Witch Repose Ritual】[/b] to your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.flavor: An elaborately decorated sword. It was previously kept in the safe. No signs of use
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.d: After ending combat, at the start of the next combat's turn, choose 3 cards to upgrade, or choose not to upgrade. For each card upgraded, lose 2 [b]Max HP[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.f: The price of information is always heavier than imagined

MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.title: Token of Identity
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.description:
[color=#ff99cc]「But being able to reunite with Yuki now makes me truly happy」[/color]

MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.de: After you deal damage to an enemy with a card, grant it 1 stage of dark-orange fire. Enemy fire is tracked in 6 stages: heating converts dark-orange to dark-red at full 6 stages, and dark-red to crimson; with 100+ stacks of 【Witchification】, crimson can convert to black-red carbonization. At the start of the player's turn, if the current enemy has dark-orange fire, you may choose 1 card from the draw pile or discard pile to add to your hand; with dark-red fire, gain 1 energy; with crimson fire, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity. This benefit belongs only to the player who applied that fire. When all cards are fewer than 13, using a fire component additionally connects 1 random Alisa card; that card costs 0 this time, and only that random card is burned.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.fl: A small thing clutched in her palm, like the last safety line not yet burned through.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.fi: Enemy fire is divided into 6 stages, tracked independently by each Alisa player. Normal damage and random damage grant dark-orange fire; residual burn does not grant fire. Heating does not add new stages, but upgrades the lowest current fire at full 6 stages: dark-orange→dark-red→crimson, and after witchification crimson→black-red. When consuming fire, consume the earliest-converted stages first and resolve by color: each dark-orange stage grants 4 Block, every 2 dark-orange stages draw 1 card; each dark-red stage makes the next non-X card cost 1 less this time and grants 1 stack of next-turn energy, this next-turn energy is capped per turn at the current energy cap, every 2 dark-red stages immediately grant 1 energy; each crimson stage deals crimson damage to a random enemy and grants equal Alisa's Magic, then crimson damage +1, every 2 crimson stages deal an extra 2nd-stage crimson damage and gain 1 Strength. At the start of the player's turn, the current enemy's dark-orange, dark-red, and crimson fire respectively provide card retrieval, energy, and Strength & Dexterity benefits.
When consuming dark-orange fire: each stage grants 4 Block. For every 2 dark-orange stages consumed, draw 1 card.

When consuming dark-red fire: each stage makes the next non-X card cost 1 less this time and grants 1 stack of next-turn energy. Next-turn energy gained this way is capped per turn at the current energy cap. For every 2 dark-red stages consumed, immediately gain 1 energy.

When consuming crimson fire: each stage deals {Damage} damage to a random enemy and grants equal Alisa's Magic, then crimson damage +1. For every 2 crimson stages consumed, deal an extra 2nd-stage crimson damage and gain 1 Strength.
A special fire after witchification. Currently resolved by witchification and black-red exclusive effects.
Choose 1 card to add to your hand
When you are about to consume the highest fire, you may consume 2 stacks of lower fire instead
